channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: firmly raises $15M Series A and launches Ask Agent for agentic commerce
item.description: firmly raised $15M and launched Ask Agent, letting shoppers discover products and check out inside a chat on merchant websites.

item.title: Kabilio raises €10M to put an AI agent inside accounting firms
item.description: Kabilio raised €10M to launch an AI agent that handles invoice and reconciliation work for accounting firms.

item.title: x402 'upto' on XRPL gets an escrow rewrite, tested on testnet
item.description: A new x402 proposal reworks metered payments on the XRP Ledger so funds are locked in escrow before a server does the work, fixing a double-payment flaw.

item.title: VMware Tanzu AI-Ready Data Foundations goes GA for governed agent data
item.description: VMware made its AI-ready data foundations generally available, giving AI agents governed, masked access to enterprise data through standard MCP servers.

item.title: AIREV lands strategic investment from Singapore's Terra Invest to expand sovereign agentic AI
item.description: Sovereign, on-prem-capable agent platforms are drawing cross-border capital, not just US venture money — AIREV's OnDemand already serves 4M+ users via 300+ agents.

item.title: Tencent launches Hy4 with vision and computer-use abilities at unchanged API pricing
item.description: Computer-use models are becoming a priced API commodity, and Tencent's reported hallucination-rate drop from 15.76% to 5.45% still needs independent validation.

item.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights: 2.8T-parameter MoE, 1M context
item.description: The strongest open-weight agent model yet is now downloadable, but its custom Kimi license — not MIT — needs a read before commercial or self-hosted use.

item.title: Vercel Labs releases agent-desktop: desktop control for AI agents via the OS accessibility tree
item.description: Accessibility-tree control could make computer-use agents cheaper and more reliable than screenshot-and-pixel-matching pipelines.

item.title: Personal Agent Protocol draft 0.3 in progress: protocol scopes dropped, MCP joins discovery
item.description: The Sierra/Meta agent-to-business spec is still pre-1.0 and breaking between drafts, so nothing should be built against it as stable yet.

item.title: Cowboy raises $5M seed to build an app store for AI agents
item.description: Its General Store opens with 100+ agents and 10,000 data feeds for hire, testing whether developers can own and monetize agents the way app developers monetized mobile.

item.title: x402 passes 196.7M payments settled, $42.4M in volume
item.description: The Nov 4 state-of-play shows x402 at 97% of onchain agent transactions in Q2 2026, but October cooled to 5.1M transactions ($274K) after the late-2025 PING minting frenzy — scale is real, steady usage is not yet.

item.title: PhoenixAI launches Contextbase, governed context infrastructure for AI agents
item.description: It puts business definitions, knowledge, agent memory, traces and evaluations in one governed, versioned store so agents read from the same verified context every run instead of scattered permissions.

item.title: Brava Security raises $15M seed to expand AI SecOps in North America
item.description: Its multi-agent platform tests whether security tools would actually catch an attack, closing the gap where agents only reason about threats they already recognize.

item.title: Leidos unveils HeadWay Dispatch for cross-vendor AI agent control
item.description: Know / Control / Prove plus a tamper-evident Flight Recorder gives enterprises a governance boundary across agents from different vendors, with autonomy set by risk.

item.title: Snowflake launches Business Ontology and expands Cortex AI Gateway
item.description: Approved business definitions plus a single governed front door for agents tackles the context-and-controls gap blocking production agent deployments.

item.title: OpenAI Agent Builder shuts down November 30: 26-day migration playbook
item.description: Agent Builder, the Evals platform and reusable prompt objects all go November 30, so teams should export workflows as Agents SDK code now, not at month-end.

item.title: Finpilot raises $10M Series A for AI agents that handle grunt work for institutional investors
item.description: Agents are moving into back-office paperwork for hospitals, pension funds and foundations, led by Lobby Capital with Madrona returning.

item.title: Together AI launches Polymorphic Inference with Together Compiler, continuously retuning inference
item.description: Inference tuning is becoming an agent-driven, continuous job rather than a one-off optimization, with reported 1.3x-3x tokens/sec over open baselines.

item.title: Sarvam AI launches Prism, a decision-making model with 44ms responses and Apache 2.0 weights
item.description: Fast, structured decisions (routing, document analysis, agent evaluation) are splitting off from general chat models into deployable, customizable small models.

item.title: Axion 1.0: open agent model family from ByteDance-linked authors, 18K examples, Apache 2.0
item.description: A plain two-stage SFT + RL recipe reportedly reaches strong agent scores, but note the 35B weights are a community reproduction, not an official checkpoint.

item.title: ReqRes launches an Agent Sandbox, a free REST API built for AI coding agents to practice against
item.description: Deterministic fixtures plus 15 deliberate failure scenarios give coding agents a realistic test surface without production risk.

item.title: Thermit raises seed led by Mashup Ventures for its Creazy commerce content agent
item.description: Sellers now need product pages optimized for AI shopping agents as well as human shoppers, and multi-agent content generation is the wedge.

item.title: Sentra raises $150M Series C to control what AI agents can reach in data
item.description: A bank's venture arm leading a $150M agent-data-security round shows controlling agent data access is now a board-level security spend, not a feature.

item.title: Shackleton AI emerges from stealth with $5M seed led by Battery Ventures for construction agent workflows
item.description: Agents are moving into construction project admin, a sector where paperwork, not code, is the bottleneck — and it already manages $1B+ in project value.

item.title: Nooks lands $500M from General Catalyst to fund its AI sales push and launches its Revenue Agent Platform
item.description: This is lending-style growth capital, not equity, and it funds an agent platform covering the full sales cycle from first contact to renewal.

item.title: Applied Compute raises $350M at a $3.25B valuation for AI infrastructure
item.description: Under 18 months old with $100M+ annualized revenue, it shows inference and model-evaluation infrastructure is still commanding premium valuations.

item.title: Orca Security extends its AI AppGen Security platform to Base44 on day one of Base44's Compliance API
item.description: No-code apps built outside CI/CD are now a governed security surface, with 30+ posture rules over apps, data schemas, agents, secrets and integrations for Base44 Enterprise workspaces.

item.title: OpenAI launches the Agents API in public beta, bringing the Codex harness to developers
item.description: OpenAI is productizing the harness itself — one API call spins up a cloud agent with managed sandboxes, automatic context compaction and subagents — so builders no longer have to build orchestration, sandboxing and long-session context management from scratch.

item.title: Traversal raises $120M at a $1B valuation for its AI site-reliability engineer
item.description: Agent money is moving from chatbots to autonomous ops — Traversal's agents diagnose and fix production incidents at Nubank, Harvey, PepsiCo and DigitalOcean, with Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint and Khosla co-leading.

item.title: Salesforce signs agreement to acquire voice-AI platform Cresta, reported at $2.7B
item.description: Voice is becoming a CRM procurement decision — Cresta's agents resolve complex customer calls end to end for Marriott, Comcast and Alaska Airlines, giving Service Cloud and Agentforce a production voice layer.

item.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler AI and Dreadnode for agent observability and AI security testing
item.description: Agent observability is consolidating into the security stack — Fiddler becomes Falcon Observe with agent evaluation, reasoning traces and drift detection, and Dreadnode adds offensive AI security testing.

item.title: Wabi raises $55M at $1.25B valuation after pivot to personal AI agent
item.description: Replika founder Eugenia Kuyda's pivot shows investor money still chasing consumer personal agents, not just enterprise copilots — IVP led, with a16z, Forerunner and the Amazon Alexa Fund in.

item.title: Clark raises $11M seed for autonomous AI audit employees for CPA firms
item.description: Agent labor is landing in regulated professional services, where audit trails and human review are the product — Clark's autonomous Clerks already serve 35+ CPA firms.

item.title: x402serps: pay-per-search for AI agents over x402, no API key
item.description: A concrete per-call agent payment primitive at sub-cent prices — $0.004 per 10 results in USDC on Base and Solana, plus an MCP server — beyond headline x402 totals.

item.title: Cloudflare Agents 0.33.0 ships Pi 1.5 support, with a one-way conversation migration
item.description: Breaking changes in agent frameworks are now a migration cost teams must budget for — upgraded Pi conversations cannot return to the previous version.

item.title: OpenKruise Agents v0.6.0: governed agent sandboxes on Kubernetes at scale
item.description: Sandboxed agent runtimes are becoming governed infrastructure, with credential injection keeping API keys out of the sandbox by design.

item.title: Platformr adds Optics Tag Manager agent and Remote MCP Server for AWS governance
item.description: Governance is moving into the agent's own tools — teams can audit and apply AWS resource tags across an organization in plain English.

item.title: Fal doubles valuation to $16B with $1.3B Series F for AI inference
item.description: Inference, not training, is where the money is piling up as open-model demand outstrips capacity — combined Series E & F total $1.65B, with annualized revenue over $800M.

item.title: Menlo Ventures: enterprise AI spending hit $176.8B, up 5.4x in a year, as agents take over
item.description: Agents are now the spending story in enterprise AI, and the market is concentrating on three frontier labs — Anthropic's enterprise API share rose to 55% while Google's fell to 9%.

item.title: Fireblocks: x402's headline counts overstate real agent commerce
item.description: x402 has cleared 196M lifetime transactions settling $42M+, but the latest full month was just 5.1M transactions and $274k — the production floor is far smaller than the November 2025 speculation peak.

item.title: CyberKord raises €2.7M pre-seed for an AI that investigates and fixes IT issues on its own
item.description: Autonomous remediation is the next step past agent copilots — agents that close tickets, not just flag them, using a digital twin of company IT infrastructure.

item.title: Granter raises €1.6M to expand its AI public-funding platform across Europe
item.description: Niche agent workflows for fragmented bureaucracy are a repeatable wedge outside the US funding race — Granter finds, prepares and manages European grant applications.

item.title: Guava raises $12.5M seed for a developer platform for AI voice agents
item.description: Voice agents are moving from demos to enterprise call volume, and Guava's Gridspace lineage (10B minutes of live call-center conversations) is a real data moat.

item.title: e2e raises €7M seed for an open-source framework testing apps in the age of AI agents
item.description: Agent-built software needs agent-native testing, and 1M+ downloads and 12,500 GitHub stars in a month say the tooling gap is real.

item.title: Trajectory raises $45M Series A at $300M valuation for continual-learning post-training
item.description: Post-training is becoming the product, not a one-off step — Harvey and Rogo already use it to make open models behave like experienced lawyers and analysts.

item.title: Mistral Large 4 goes open weight: ~1T-parameter multimodal model, 1M-token context
item.description: The top of the open-weight field is now crowded at trillion-parameter scale, and Mistral claims the lead among open models on coding-agent benchmarks.

item.title: NVIDIA publishes Auto Ontology, an open-source agent context layer over MCP
item.description: Agents are only as good as the business meaning they can see, and this is a free, standard way to give them governed context instead of raw tables.

item.title: Snowflake launches Business Ontology and Cortex AI Gateway for governed agent context
item.description: 55% of executives blame missing business context for bad agent output, and Snowflake is betting governance becomes the foundation agents are built on, not bolted on after.

item.title: Mintive raises $7M seed led by Cowboy Ventures for AI agent identity
item.description: Agent identity is becoming its own funded infrastructure layer, not a feature — ex-MintMCP, angels include Jeff Dean and Andrej Karpathy, 50+ paying customers since February.

item.title: Manicule raises $1.3M seed co-led by Y Combinator for 'Agent Relations'
item.description: Distribution is shifting from SEO for humans to discoverability for agents — software that agents can find, recommend, and use.
